_about: DEMO DATA. Fictional notices for 'Demo City Transit'. Times are offsets from the moment the demo feed is reset, so the demo always contains active, upcoming and expired notices. These are not real transport announcements. Map positions are arbitrary offsets from map_center and are NOT real closures.

notices.title: Riverside Bridge closed for maintenance
notices.area: Riverside Bridge and Old Dock Road
notices.summary: Buses on routes 12A and 12B cannot cross Riverside Bridge. Board at the temporary stops on Old Dock Road.

notices.title: Market Road diversion for street festival

notices.title: Signal fault causing delays on Express 7X
notices.summary: Expect delays of up to 15 minutes while the signal fault is repaired.

notices.title: Lakeside stop relocated, end date not announced
